comparison: one M1/M2 pair against unchanged M0; no selection across seeds
panel_binding: freeze exact row/skill/condition/rendering/joined-parent assignments before scores; analysis requires that pre-score metadata SHA256, preventing post-hoc regrouping
atomic_endpoint: equal-weight macro-average R/S accuracy, first average four rows within each joined parent component
RS_endpoint: separate held-out RS component accuracy; never substitute for the atomic endpoint

bootstrap.method: paired percentile cluster bootstrap within each skill; same resampled component index for both arms

retention.enrollment: caller explicitly freezes complete domain IDs/classes/row IDs/component IDs and all M0 scores before candidate outputs
retention.enrollment_binding: analysis requires the enrollment SHA256 fixed in the pre-candidate manifest, including its explicit unchanged baseline ID; a self-consistent later subset cannot replace it
retention.eligible_unit: joined parent component with at least one M0-correct row
retention.failure: any enrolled prior-correct row lost makes its component a failure
retention.repairs: reported separately; never offset a loss or increase the retention denominator
retention.upper_bound: exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson binomial CDF inversion; zero-loss bound is 1-alpha^(1/n)
retention.scorer_metadata: caller-qualified scorer, label and qualification-receipt SHA256 bindings for each domain; missing/unqualified bindings leave a computational screen only

interpretation: One training seed cannot confirm general condition-diversity transfer, broad retention, or training-seed reliability. Binary inputs do not qualify a grader. No shifted permutation noninferiority procedure is used.
